info.name: Fyno Rest Fire an Event Suppression List API

params.name: WSID
params.description: Enter your workspace ID. You can obtain this value from the API Keys page within your Fyno account.

items.docs:
The Suppression List API enables you to manage users who should be excluded from receiving communications on specific channels.

This API enables you to retrieve the list of all suppressed users across various channels.

params.name: WSID
params.description: Enter your workspace ID. You can obtain this value from the API Keys page within your Fyno account.

items.docs:
Add a user to the suppression list for a given channel.

Note: If both `distinct_id` and `destination` are provided, `distinct_id` takes precedence, and `destination` is ignored.

params.name: WSID
params.description: Enter your workspace ID. You can obtain this value from the API Keys page within your Fyno account.

params.name: _id
params.description: Unique identifier of the suppression record to delete.

params.name: distinct_id
params.description: Unique identifier (used as an alternative to destination)

params.name: destination
params.description: Phone number or email of the suppressed user

items.docs:
Delete a suppression entry using its `_id`, `distinct_id`, `destination`.

Note: If all three values (`distinct_id`, `destination`, `_id`) are provided, `_id` takes precedence followed by `distinct_id`.
